== the events a compact log needs (all fields below are in the capture; field paths in properties.*)
   assistant text, final:   message.part.updated  part.type=text   part.time.end set  (part.text is the full text; deltas are redundant)
   reasoning (optional):    message.part.updated  part.type=reasoning part.time.end set
   tool call:               message.part.updated  part.type=tool  part.tool, part.state.status pending|running|completed|error, part.state.input (+ .output / .error when done)
   usage/ctx per step:      message.part.updated  part.type=step-finish  part.tokens {total,input,output,reasoning,cache{read,write}}, part.cost, part.reason
   usage per assistant msg: message.updated       info.role=assistant info.tokens (same shape), info.finish, info.time.completed, info.modelID/providerID, info.error
   turn start/end:          session.status properties.status.type busy|idle (a busy is repeated; take the last), session.idle (alias)
   abort/failure:           session.error properties.error.name (MessageAbortedError, ...)
   a steered-in user msg:   message.updated info.role=user (+ message.part.updated part.type=text) while the session is busy
   skip: message.part.delta (one per token), plugin.added / catalog.updated / reference.updated / integration.updated (instance boot), session.updated, session.diff, server.heartbeat (every 10 s)
